title: Site optimizer: New metrics for field options and work item security levels
description:
Jira admins can now monitor usage for field options and work item security levels within the Site optimizer. These new metrics help admins stay within recommended guardrails and maintain optimal app performance by identifying when resource usage reaches or exceeds limits. Log in to Jira with admin access.
	Select Settings, then System, then Site optimizer.
